bl99.reason: Bl99 is new CFHT Halpha analysis using pre-existing 20-arcsec Westerbork H I; its text says H I kinematics are from Cote, Carignan & Sancisi 1991 and the gas contribution uses that H I radial profile scaled by 1.33 for helium. Public source package has TeX plus figures but no numerical H I profile sidecar.

co91.reason: Co91 directly publishes Figure 6 raw radial H I surface density, derived from average H I brightness in concentric ellipses with cos(i) correction; helium x4/3 is applied only later in mass modeling. Current bounded public ADS copy is scan/raster-only with zero native drawings and no exact machine-readable series established.

boundary: No OCR, raster digitization, ad-hoc map/cube reconstruction, blind rotation-outcome inspection, profile fitting, or persistence fitting. L_A and C_A remain locked.
